items.headline: Small open models now run well on a Raspberry Pi 5
items.blurb: A new round of 3B-parameter models answers at reading speed on an 8 GB Pi, with no GPU and no network.

items.headline: Agents learn to write their own dashboards
items.blurb: Home assistants now write small JSON feeds for wall displays: weather, chores, and what is on tonight.

items.headline: ztaylor/glowdots: 1990s pinball dot matrix displays
items.blurb: A Rust engine for plasma-orange DMD scenes with glow, bloom, afterglow, and pinball transitions. Runs in a window, a browser, or on a Pi.

items.headline: Show HN: I rebuilt a Williams DMD in a shader
items.blurb: Round dots, a white-hot core, a tight halo, and a wide bloom. The trick is the 4 shades: gamma spreads them apart so dim text still reads.

items.headline: Ordered dithering, revisited for very small displays
items.blurb: With only four shades, a 4x4 Bayer matrix gives smooth gradients that hold still from frame to frame, unlike error diffusion.
